title: 5 Fastest Cars On Earth — Number 1 Is Terrifying
narration:
These mind-blowing hypercars push human engineering to the absolute limit. You will not believe how fast they run. But number one goes so ridiculously fast, it feels almost terrifying...

Starting off at number five... we have the Rimac Nevera! This all-electric monster packs four motors that unleash nearly two thousand horsepower. It shoots from zero to sixty miles per hour in under two seconds... That makes it faster off the line than a modern Formula One race car!

Coming in at number four... it is the insane Hennessey Venom F5! Built in Texas, this terrifying machine houses a twin-turbo engine with over eighteen hundred horsepower. It is built out of carbon fiber and was engineered specifically to crush three hundred miles per hour...

Sliding into the number three spot... the sleek SSC Tuatara! This aerodynamic masterpiece weighs less than a tiny compact car while generating incredible speed. It reached proven test speeds of nearly three hundred miles per hour... Its smooth body cuts through the air like a razor blade.

At number two... the world-famous Bugatti Chiron Super Sport! This four-million-dollar land rocket became the first official road car to break three hundred miles per hour. It burns through an entire tank of gasoline in under ten minutes when pushing at its absolute top speed...

And finally... sitting at number one... the utterly terrifying Koenigsegg Jesko Absolut! This Swedish speed demon is computer-designed to soar past three hundred and ten miles per hour... It features long rear fins inspired by fighter jets to maintain stability. Nothing on four wheels matches this level of pure speed!

Which of these crazy hypercars would you dare to drive at top speed? Drop your ranking in the comments below!

title: 5 Largest Volcanoes On Earth — Number 1 Is Terrifying 🌋
narration: Deep beneath our feet, nature hides monsters so massive they can crush the ocean floor. Number one on this list is so unimaginably huge, its sheer weight bends the Earth's tectonic plate... At number 5, Mount Kilimanjaro. Rising nearly 6,000 meters above the plains of Africa, this giant holds icy glaciers right near the hot equator. It is so tall, it creates its own weather system. At number 4, Yellowstone Supervolcano. Hidden underneath an entire national park, this underground monster spans nearly 70 kilometers across. A super-eruption could bury half of North America under thick, deadly ash. At number 3, Tamu Massif. Resting deep beneath the Pacific Ocean, this extinct giant covers an area almost as big as the British Isles. It spans over 300,000 square kilometers on the seafloor. At number 2, Pūhāhonu. Hidden in the Hawaiian ocean chain, this shield volcano holds nearly 150,000 cubic kilometers of rock. It is twice the volume of Mauna Loa, with burning hot magma deep inside. And at number 1, Mauna Loa. Rising over 9,000 meters from the ocean floor, this active giant covers more than half of Hawaii. Its terrifying weight literally forces the ocean floor miles deep into the Earth. Which of these giant monsters scares you the most? Tell us your ranking in the comments!

title: 5 Largest Stadiums Ever Built — Number 1 Is Terrifying 🏟️
narration: Human beings love building massive arenas, but the single largest stadium on Earth is so big it feels almost terrifying... Starting at number 5... Ohio Stadium. Located in the United States, this gigantic venue can hold over 100,000 screaming fans at once. The entire building is shaped like a giant horseshoe to squeeze in more seats. At number 4... Beaver Stadium. This massive college arena can fit nearly 107,000 people inside its walls. The crowd noise during big games is so loud that it can actually trigger earthquake sensors. Coming in at number 3... Michigan Stadium. Famous around the world as The Big House, it comfortably seats over 107,000 spectators. It is so gigantic that passengers can easily spot it from airplane windows high in the sky. At number 2... May Day Stadium. Built in North Korea, this colossal structure seats over 114,000 people inside. Its massive roof looks like sixteen giant flower petals curving over the crowd. And at number 1... Narendra Modi Stadium. Built in India, this giant arena holds a mind-blowing 132,000 people. Standing on the field feels like sitting at the bottom of a giant ocean of human voices. title: 5 Longest Rivers On Earth — Number 1 Is Terrifying 🌊
narration: These giant rivers flow across whole continents, but number one hides dark currents and terrifying creatures that shock the world. Starting at number five, ... the Yenisey River. Flowing over three thousand three hundred miles across Russia, it freezes solid every winter. Massive ice chunks crush anything in their path when the spring thaw arrives. At number four, ... the Mississippi River. This American giant cuts through ten states and spans over two thousand three hundred miles. Its muddy waters contain hidden sinkholes and dangerous currents that easily drag swimmers under. Coming in at number three, ... the Yangtze River. Stretching over three thousand nine hundred miles across China, it is the longest river in Asia. Deep river canyons hide giant sturgeon and sudden violent floods. At number two, ... the Nile River. Winding over four thousand one hundred miles through Africa, it feeds millions of people. Deadly Nile crocodiles and aggressive hippos hunt along its muddy shores every day. And at number one, ... the Amazon River. Flowing over four thousand miles through South America, this terrifying river holds more water than the next seven largest rivers combined. Giant anacondas, flesh-eating piranhas, and electric eels hide beneath its dark surface. Which of these massive giant rivers would you dare to explore?

title: 5 Tallest Statues On Earth — Number 1 Is Terrifying 🗿
narration: Human beings build gigantic monuments, but some colossal figures loom over landscapes like real giants. Wait until you see number one, because its height makes skyscraper towers look tiny. Coming in at number five... is the Sendai Daikannon in Japan. This pure white goddess stands nearly one hundred meters tall. Visitors can take an elevator inside to see awesome views across the entire city. At number four... we have the Ushiku Daibutsu, also located in Japan. This massive bronze statue reaches over one hundred meters into the sky. It is four times taller than the famous Statue of Liberty. Sliding into number three... is the Laykyun Sekkya in Myanmar. This towering golden figure reaches nearly one hundred twenty meters high. Construction took over ten years of intense work to complete. Reaching number two... is the Spring Temple Buddha in China. Standing almost one hundred thirty meters tall, it sits on a gigantic lotus throne. The giant monument contains thousands of tons of steel and copper. And at number one... is the unbelievable Statue of Unity in India. Rising over one hundred eighty meters tall, it is currently the absolute tallest statue on Earth. You can actually see this giant structure from miles away. Which of these giant statues would you dare to climb? Tell us in the comments!

title: 5 Largest Sharks Ever — Number 1 Is Terrifying 🦈
narration: Monsters have ruled the deep ocean for millions of years, but one giant shark was so massive it ate full sized whales. You will not believe how big number 1 really was. Starting at number 5, we have the... Ginsu Shark. Living millions of years ago, this ancient hunter grew up to 8 meters long. Its razor sharp teeth could easily slice through hard bone. Coming in at number 4 is the... Basking Shark. Swimming in modern oceans today, this massive giant reaches nearly 10 meters long. It glides through the deep ocean with a mouth huge enough to fit a person. At number 3, we find the... Otodus Chubutensis. This prehistoric ocean monster stretched over 12 meters long. It ruled warm coastal waters and hunted large prey with massive, sharp teeth. Stepping up to number 2 is the... Whale Shark. As the largest living fish today, it grows over 18 meters long and weighs over 20 tons. Thankfully, this underwater giant only eats tiny plankton. And at number 1, the terrifying... Megalodon. This legendary predator reached over 18 meters long and weighed around 50 tons. Its giant jaws possessed a bite force strong enough to crush a car. Which of these giant sharks scares you the most? Drop your own ranking in the comments below!

narration: These giant creatures make humans look like tiny ants. But wait until you see the largest animal that has ever existed... At number 5... the African Elephant. It is the largest land animal in the world today. These giant beasts can weigh over seven tons and stand nearly four meters tall. They eat over three hundred pounds of food every single day. At number 4... the Colossal Squid. Living deep in the ocean, this monster is the largest invertebrate on the planet. It stretches over thirty feet long and has eyes as big as dinner plates. At number 3... the Sperm Whale. It is the largest toothed predator on Earth. This massive giant can dive over two thousand meters deep into the dark sea to hunt. At number 2... the Fin Whale. Known as the greyhound of the sea, it reaches lengths of nearly eighty-five feet. It can swim at speeds of over twenty miles per hour despite its massive body. And at number 1... the Blue Whale. This underwater titan is larger than any dinosaur that ever lived. Weighing nearly two hundred tons, its heart alone is as big as a small car. Which of these giant creatures would you least want to meet in the ocean? Comment your ranking below!

narration: The ocean has produced some truly massive ocean monsters throughout earth history, but the largest oceanic killer was bigger than a city bus. Here are the five biggest sharks that ever lived... Starting at number 5, we have... Cretoxyrhina. Known as the Ginsu shark, this ancient ocean killer swam ninety million years ago. It cruises open oceans with a giant mouth to feed on tiny plankton. Coming in at number 3, we find... Otodus Chubutensis. This prehistoric terror reached nearly thirteen meters long. title: 5 Deepest Ocean Trenches — Number 1 Is Terrifying 🌊
narration: The ocean floor holds pitch black abysses deep enough to swallow Mount Everest whole. But the deepest place on Earth hides a terrifying secret in total darkness... At number 5, we have the... Kermadec Trench. Located in the South Pacific, this underwater canyon drops over 10,000 meters down. Sunlight completely disappears near the top, leaving pitch black freezing water. Coming in at number 4 is the... Kuril Trench. Sitting near Russia, this icy abyss plunges nearly 10,500 meters deep. Extremely rare deep sea creatures survive here under massive crushing water pressure. At number 3, we reveal the... Philippine Trench. Dropping over 10,500 meters into the Pacific Ocean floor, it is so deep that sunlight never touches its bottom. The water pressure here would easily crush a military submarine. Floating into number 2, it is the... Tonga Trench. This giant ocean trench reaches down over 10,800 meters deep. It houses the Horizon Deep, where weird glowing ocean life lives in complete isolation. And at number 1, the terrifying deepest point on Earth... the Mariana Trench. Plunging nearly 11,000 meters into total darkness, its bottom is called Challenger Deep. The pressure at the bottom is over 1,000 times greater than at sea level. Which of these ocean depths terrifies you the most? Comment your ranking below!

title: Which Item Cost Over $60 Trillion? 💰
narration: Some items cost millions of dollars, but the single most valuable material in existence costs tens of trillions for just one tiny gram. Here are the top five most expensive things ever sold or created. At number 5... Salvator Mundi. Painted by Leonardo da Vinci, this mysterious portrait sold at auction for over 450 million dollars. It remains the most expensive piece of art ever purchased. At number 4... Villa Leopolda. Located on the French Riviera, this historic luxury mansion was bought for nearly 750 million dollars. It features over ten bedrooms, outdoor pools, and giant private gardens. At number 3... History Supreme. This custom luxury superyacht was bought for about 4.8 billion dollars. Its wild price comes from being covered in over 100,000 kilograms of solid gold and platinum. At number 2... the Space Station. Built through a global partnership, this giant research facility orbiting Earth cost over 150 billion dollars to construct. It is the most expensive single object ever created. And at number 1... Antimatter. Producing just one single gram of this rare substance costs an estimated 60 trillion dollars. Scientists must use complex particle accelerators to make tiny amounts. Which of these crazy price tags surprised you the most? Tell us your ranking in the comments!

title: Where Is the Most Isolated Town on Earth? 🌍
narration: Some communities live so far from civilization that the closest humans are astronauts floating in orbit. The most isolated town on Earth sits thousands of miles from any continent. At number 5, Alert, Canada... This icy outpost sits just five hundred miles from the North Pole. Winters bring months of total darkness, with temperatures plunging below minus forty degrees. Number 4, Ittoqqortoormiit, Greenland... Frozen sea ice traps this colorful village for about nine months every year. Only around four hundred hardy people live here, surrounded by glaciers and polar bears. Coming in at number 3, Easter Island... Famous for its giant stone heads, this volcanic island sits over two thousand miles from mainland Chile. Reaching other people requires crossing immense stretches of ocean. Number 2, Pitcairn Island... Fewer than fifty residents live on this tiny Pacific speck. There is no airport anywhere on the island, so supply boats visit only every few months. And at number 1, Tristan da Cunha... This volcanic rock is the most remote inhabited island on Earth. It sits over fifteen hundred miles from any mainland, and reaching it takes nearly a week at sea. Tell us in the comments, could you survive living this far from modern civilization?

title: Which Animal Kills the Most Humans? 🐍
narration: Which tiny creature actually kills more humans than lions, sharks, and bears combined? The single deadliest animal on Earth might be buzzing in your home right now. Starting at number 5... the Hippopotamus. Do not let their calm swimming fool you. Hippos are fiercely territorial. Weighing up to four tons, their massive jaws snap boats in half, causing around 500 human deaths every year. At number 4... the Saltwater Crocodile. Waiting silently under murky water, these ambush predators attack without warning. Their bite force exceeds 3,000 pounds per square inch, claiming nearly 1,000 lives every year across tropical rivers. Coming in at number 3... the Domestic Dog. Man's best friend hides a tragic danger. Infected dogs spread rabies through bites, leading to over 30,000 human deaths annually, mostly in rural communities. At number 2... the Snake. Deadly venom from vipers and cobras can stop a human heart within hours. Venomous snakes cause over 100,000 human deaths worldwide every single year. And at number 1... the absolute deadliest creature on Earth is the Mosquito. This tiny insect carries fatal diseases like malaria. Spreading microscopic parasites, mosquitoes kill over 700,000 people every single year. Which of these dangerous creatures scares you the most? Comment your thoughts down below!

It can comfortably carry about 470 passengers across giant oceans without stopping for fuel at all. At number 4... the Boeing 777X. It is the longest twin-engine passenger jet in the world at nearly 77 meters. Its unique folding wingtips allow it to fit easily into normal airport gates. At number 3... the Boeing 747-400. This legendary jumbo jet features an iconic upper deck bump. It safely carried over 400 travelers on long international journeys for many decades. At number 2... the Boeing 747-8. As the largest official version of the famous Queen of the Skies, it stretches over 76 meters long. It carries nearly 470 passengers in complete high-end comfort. And at number 1... the Airbus A380. title: 5 Tallest Mountains on Earth 🏔️
narration: The giant peaks on our planet reach high into the freezing sky. But one famous mountain towers above all the rest... At number 5... Makalu. This sharp peak sits right on the border of Nepal and China. It stands at over 8,400 meters tall. Climbers know it well for its steep pyramid shape and sharp icy ridges. At number 4... Lhotse. It reaches over 8,500 meters into the thin air. This giant mountain connects directly to its famous neighbor by a high pass. It features a massive vertical wall on its south face. At number 3... Kangchenjunga. It rises to nearly 8,600 meters high. It is the easternmost giant peak of the high Himalayas. For many years, early explorers thought it was actually the highest point on Earth. At number 2... K2. It stands at over 8,600 meters tall in the Karakoram range. Fierce winds, extreme weather, and icy slopes make it one of the deadliest and hardest peaks to climb. And at number 1... Mount Everest. It towers at over 8,800 meters above sea level. This iconic giant attracts mountain climbers from around the world and continues to grow a tiny bit taller every single year. Which of these massive peaks would you want to visit, and how would you rank them?

narration: Some creatures on Earth move so fast they seem almost impossible. But the absolute speed champion dives through the sky faster than a racing sports car. At number 4... the Black Marlin. This ocean powerhouse cuts through water at speeds over 80 miles per hour. Its sharp bill and massive tail help it outrun almost every sea creature. At number 3... the Spur-winged Goose. This large bird can fly horizontally at nearly 90 miles per hour. It easily travels huge distances across wetlands faster than most small aircraft. At number 2... the Golden Eagle. When hunting prey, this massive bird of prey dives at speeds over 150 miles per hour. Its incredible eyesight lets it spot targets from thousands of feet up. And at number 1... the Peregrine Falcon. In a high-speed hunting dive, this incredible bird reaches speeds over 200 miles per hour. That makes it the undisputed speed king of the entire planet. title: 5 Largest Islands on Earth 🏝️
narration: Some landmasses on our planet are so massive they rival entire continents. And the biggest island on Earth is covered almost entirely in thick ice. Starting off at number 5, Baffin Island... Located in northern Canada, this arctic land covers over 500,000 square kilometers. It is famous for its massive fjords and wandering polar bears. Coming in at number 4, Madagascar... Sitting off the coast of East Africa, this island spans over 580,000 square kilometers. Nearly 90 percent of its wildlife is found nowhere else on Earth. Moving to number 3, Borneo... Spanning over 740,000 square kilometers in Southeast Asia, it is shared by three separate nations. It features ancient rainforests packed with wild orangutans. Up next at number 2, New Guinea... Covering nearly 790,000 square kilometers, this tropical land sits in the Pacific Ocean. It is known for its soaring mountains, deep jungles, and unique native cultures. And finally, at number 1, Greenland... Stretching over an astonishing 2.1 million square kilometers, it is almost three times larger than any other island. Nearly 80 percent of its land is locked beneath a giant ice sheet. Which of these incredible giant islands would you love to visit? Comment your ranking below!
